definitions.explanation: Describes a person or lifestyle that is restrained, unpretentious, and avoids excess or ostentation. Carries a positive connotation of admirable self-restraint and quiet dignity.

examples.japanese: {慎|つつま}ましい⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{慎|つつま}ましい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{話|はな}さない→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother is a reserved person and doesn't talk about herself much.

examples.japanese: {慎|つつま}ましい⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{幸|しあわ}せな⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: They lead a humble but happy life.

notes: A positive word expressing admiration for someone's modesty and restraint. Common collocations: {慎|つつま}ましい⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧ (modest living), {慎|つつま}ましい⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (reserved demeanor), {慎|つつま}ましやかな (a more literary variant). Often used to describe people who live within their means without complaint. Distinguished from ⟦{謙虚|けんきょ}→謙虚：00215_kenkyo⟧ (humble in attitude/speech) — {慎|つつま}ましい emphasizes restraint in lifestyle and behavior rather than verbal humility.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {慎|つつま}ましくなかったら
